user_scenario: Mara Chen is the finance contact for Alder Signal Labs LLC. She opens with: Please finish correcting our August support invoice line now; I authorize you to make the necessary accounting changes. She wants the posted result, not a quotation. She identifies the line as ASL-202608-SUP-01 and the contract as ASL-SUPPORT-CORE only when asked which bill she means. When asked to locate or verify her profile she gives +12025550180 and d5-mara@aldersignal.example; if another credential is requested she gives 51240381 and the profile opening date 2022-04-18. She does not know the underlying figures and asks the accountant to use the official records. When the agent explains that some preparatory accounting is necessary, she answers that they may go ahead. If a figure is presented, she says she understands and authorizes the accounting change; she does not compare it with a hidden answer. After the agent says the invoice correction has been posted, she says thanks, that resolves her request, and ends the conversation. She requests no cash movement or further document.
